ember-lp: Mahogany body with a maple top in deep ocean blue. Two humbuckers give a thick, warm overdrive.
surf-s: Alder body in seafoam blue with three single-coils. A glassy clean tone for funk, indie and surf.
brass-t: Ash body in sunburst with a brass bridge. A snappy attack for country, blues and rock.
sunburst-sc: A cutaway electro-acoustic with a built-in tuner. Easy access to the upper frets and a clean tone on stage.
canary-12: A twelve-string dreadnought in bright yellow lacquer. A shimmering, chorus-like ring straight off a seventies folk record.
parlour-nat: A small parlour body and short scale. A light guitar for home, travel and first chords.
walnut-ga: Solid spruce top with walnut back and sides. A balanced voice for both fingerstyle and strumming.
nocturne-eq: A matte black cutaway dreadnought with a pickup. Plug it into the desk and walk on stage.
stage-five: A five-piece birch kit in white lacquer, hardware included. A 22″ kick and bright toms for the club stage.
mesh-e: An electronic kit with mesh heads. Quiet practice on headphones and recording straight to your computer.
blue-snare: A maple snare in blue burst. A dry crack when you play soft and a big rimshot when you dig in.
dark-ride: A dark, hand-hammered flat ride with no bell. A dry, articulate stick sound for jazz and the studio.
quick-hat: A pair of 15″ hi-hats with a fast response. A tight foot chick and a sizzling open sound.
bright-splash: A small, bright splash for accents. It flashes and fades in an instant.
practice-15: A 15-watt combo with clean and drive channels. A headphone output for practising at night.
club-fx-15: A compact combo with built-in effects: delay, chorus, reverb. Everything you need for the first rehearsal.
red-drive: An overdrive pedal with a three-band EQ. From a light crunch to a thick rock drive.
board-seven: A ready set of seven pedals plus a multi-effect: fuzz, chorus, delay, wah and more. Assembled and tested.
acoustic-strings: A medium-gauge set in phosphor bronze. We fit them on every acoustic before it ships.
pick-sampler: Twenty-six picks in different gauges and shapes. Find yours without buying each one separately.
hickory-5a: Three pairs of hickory 5A sticks with wood tips. An all-round weight for any style.
braided-cable: An instrument cable in a woven jacket with a right-angle jack. It does not tangle or crackle.
open-back: Open-back headphones for mixing and practising on electronic drums. Honest mids and soft pads.
